'''Varan Gault''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Varan was the son of [[Orrin Gault]], the younger brother of [[Mullen Gault]] and the twin brother of [[Veeka Gault]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] in an accident when he was sixteen years old.<ref name="Kenobi" />
